location: Ashton Park Apartments, 1300 block of River Street
title: Robbery during drug deal ends in fatal shooting
charges: Malice murder, armed robbery, aggravated assault (allegations)
summary: Police reported a 24-year-old was killed when two 17-year-olds allegedly pulled guns to rob him during a drug deal. The victim fired back and one suspect was wounded. Also indexed as a shooting; people shot are counted there only.

title: Man shot in leg during attempted armed robbery
charges: Armed robbery, aggravated assault, aggravated battery, gun charges (warrants)
summary: Police reported a 62-year-old man was shot in the leg during an attempted robbery; a warrant was issued for a suspect described as armed and dangerous. Also indexed as a shooting; people shot are counted there only.

title: Infant taken in violent domestic incident; robbery among charges
charges: Kidnapping, aggravated stalking, robbery, obstruction, attempted removal of an officer's weapon (allegations)
summary: Police reported a 20-year-old man allegedly took a woman's 9-month-old without permission and fought an officer at the door, trying to pull the officer's gun. The baby was found unharmed. Domestic case; listed as a robbery because of the robbery charge.

title: Robbery at rifle-point leads to 3-hour standoff
charges: Robbery, aggravated battery, felon in possession, obstruction (allegations)
summary: Police reported a 26-year-old man allegedly took a rifle from a vehicle, pointed it at the owner and demanded money, then barricaded himself in an apartment and falsely claimed to hold a hostage. He surrendered after about three hours. No injuries were reported.
